subject: [PATCH] rseq: defer time slice extension yield for sys_futex_wake

reviews.author: Dmitry Ilvokhin
reviews.summary: Asked about publicly available implementation of a mutex combining rseq time-slice extensions and futexes, expressed interest in learning more about their interaction.

reviews.author: Alice Ryhl
reviews.summary: Provided pseudocode for a mutex implementation combining rseq time-slice extensions and futexes, discussed potential issues with preemption while holding the lock.

2026-09-01.patch_summary: Patch proposes deferring time slice extension yield for sys_futex_wake in rseq implementation.
